# Vue Star Rate — Full Reference (vue-js-star-rating)

> Zero-dependency Vue 3.5+ star rating component. WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessible. TypeScript-first. Half-star precision. Tree-shakeable lazy-loaded Lucide / FontAwesome / custom icon providers. SSR & Nuxt 3 ready.

This document is the long-form, LLM-optimized reference: install steps, every prop, every event, every slot, accessibility contract, performance notes, frequently asked questions, and migration guidance — flattened into a single text file for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and chat-style answer engines.

---

## 1. Summary

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| npm package | `vue-js-star-rating` |
| Current version | 3.1.0 (2026-05-11) |
| License | MIT |
| Author | Pooya Golchian — https://pooya.blog |
| Repo | https://github.com/pooyagolchian/vue-star-rate |
| Docs / live demo | https://pooyagolchian.github.io/vue-star-rate/ |
| Peer dep | `vue ^3.5.0` |
| Runtime deps | none |
| Optional peers | `lucide-vue-next` (only for Lucide provider), `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` (only for FontAwesome provider) |
| Default bundle | ~3 KB gzipped (component + composable + default SVG icon) |
| Node engines | >= 18 |
| Module formats | ESM (`vue-star-rate.js`) + UMD (`vue-star-rate.umd.cjs`) + d.ts |
| Accessibility | WCAG 2.2 Level AA — keyboard navigation, ARIA, `prefers-reduced-motion` |
| SSR | safe (default provider renders server-side; async chunks resolve on client) |
| Nuxt 3 | compatible — wrap in `<ClientOnly>` if you need the icon present in initial HTML |

---

## 2. Installation

```bash
# pnpm (recommended)
pnpm add vue-js-star-rating

# npm
npm install vue-js-star-rating

# yarn
yarn add vue-js-star-rating
```

Optional peers — install only the one matching your chosen provider:

```bash
pnpm add lucide-vue-next               # for icon-provider="lucide"
pnpm add @fortawesome/fontawesome-free # for icon-provider="fontawesome" (provides the .fa-* CSS classes)
```

---

## 3. Quick start

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { VueStarRate } from 'vue-js-star-rating';
import 'vue-js-star-rating/dist/style.css';

const rating = ref(0);
</script>

<template>
  <VueStarRate v-model="rating" />
</template>
```

### Global plugin registration

```ts
// main.ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import App from './App.vue';
import VueStarRatePlugin from 'vue-js-star-rating';
import 'vue-js-star-rating/dist/style.css';

createApp(App).use(VueStarRatePlugin).mount('#app');
```

---

## 4. Props (complete)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` / `modelValue` | `number` | `0` | Current rating value |
| `maxStars` | `number` | `5` | Maximum number of stars |
| `allowHalf` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable 0.5-step ratings |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` | Size preset (16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 40 px) |
| `iconSize` | `number \| { width: number; height: number }` | auto | Override pixel size |
| `iconProvider` | `'custom' \| 'lucide' \| 'fontawesome'` | `'custom'` | Icon renderer (custom uses the bundled SVG fallback when no slot is provided) |
| `colors` | `Partial<StarColors>` | see §6 | Color configuration |
| `animation` | `Partial<AnimationConfig>` | see §6 | Animation configuration |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable user interaction (clickable false, focusable true) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable + grey out the entire component |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when rating > 0 |
| `allowReset` | `boolean` | `true` | Click the active star again to reset |
| `showCounter` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the rating counter |
| `counterTemplate` | `string` | `'{value} / {max}'` | Counter template; tokens `{value}` and `{max}` are replaced |
| `showTooltip` | `boolean` | `false` | Show `title` tooltips on star hover |
| `tooltipLabels` | `string[]` | — | Custom tooltip text per star (index-based) |
| `minRating` | `number` | `0` | Minimum selectable value |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | Increment step (overridden by `allowHalf`) |
| `rtl` | `boolean` | `false` | Right-to-left layout |
| `inline` | `boolean` | `false` | Inline layout mode |
| `gap` | `number` | `4` | Gap between stars in pixels |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `'Star rating'` | Accessible group label |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra CSS class on the root element |
| `faIcons` | `{ empty?: string; filled?: string; half?: string }` | — | FontAwesome class overrides |
| `customIcon` | `CustomIconRenderer` | — | Programmatic icon render function |

### `StarColors` interface

```ts
interface StarColors {
  empty: string;  // default '#d1d5db'
  filled: string; // default '#fbbf24'
  hover: string;  // default '#f59e0b'
  half?: string;  // default = filled
}
```

### `AnimationConfig` interface

```ts
interface AnimationConfig {
  enabled: boolean;                                 // default true
  duration: number;                                 // default 200 ms
  type: 'scale' | 'bounce' | 'pulse' | 'none';      // default 'scale'
}
```

Animations are automatically suppressed when the user has `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` set at the OS level.

---

## 5. Events

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:modelValue` | `number` | Emitted by `v-model` (handled automatically) |
| `change` | `(value: number, oldValue: number)` | Emitted on user-initiated changes only (external `v-model` writes do not re-emit) |
| `hover` | `number \| null` | Hover enters or leaves a star (null on leave) |
| `focus` | `()` | Component received keyboard focus |
| `blur` | `()` | Component lost focus |

---

## 6. Slots

| Slot | Scoped props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `{ filled, half, size, color, index }` | Custom icon per star (used when `iconProvider="custom"`) |
| `counter` | `{ value, max }` | Custom counter content |
| `clear` | — | Custom clear button content |

---

## 7. Keyboard navigation

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `→`, `↑` | Increase rating by step |
| `←`, `↓` | Decrease rating by step |
| `Home` | Set to `minRating` |
| `End` | Set to `maxStars` |
| `1`–`9` | Jump to numeric value (clamped) |
| `0` | Reset to `minRating` |

---

## 8. Exposed methods

```ts
const star = ref<InstanceType<typeof VueStarRate>>();

star.value?.reset();          // back to initial value
star.value?.setRating(3.5);   // set programmatically
star.value?.getRating();      // current value
star.value?.focus();          // focus the root element
star.value?.blur();           // remove focus
```

---

## 9. Composable — `useStarRating`

Headless API exported alongside the component:

```ts
import { useStarRating } from 'vue-js-star-rating';

const {
  stars,         // computed StarItem[]
  displayRating, // computed number (hover-aware)
  isHovering,
  isFocused,
  handleClick,
  handleMouseEnter,
  handleMouseLeave,
  handleKeyDown,
  reset,
  setRating,
  getRating,
  setFocused,
} = useStarRating(options, emit);
```

Options accept `MaybeRefOrGetter<T>` for full reactivity.

---

## 10. Bundle composition

| Path taken by consumer | Bundle additions |
| --- | --- |
| `import { VueStarRate }` + default icon | Component + SVG path (~3 KB gz) |
| `<VueStarRate icon-provider="lucide" />` | + async `LucideIcon-[hash].js` chunk + `lucide-vue-next` |
| `<VueStarRate icon-provider="fontawesome" />` | + async `FontAwesomeIcon-[hash].js` chunk (you provide the FA CSS) |
| `<VueStarRate icon-provider="custom"><template #icon /></VueStarRate>` | Component only — your slot markup wins |

The lazy-loaded providers were introduced in v3.1.0 in response to GitHub issue #7, where consumers who picked the FontAwesome provider were still forced to install `lucide-vue-next`. After the fix, the static dependency graph from `import { VueStarRate } from 'vue-js-star-rating'` no longer touches `lucide-vue-next`.

---

## 11. Accessibility contract

- Container: `role="group"` + `aria-label` (configurable via `ariaLabel`); `aria-readonly`, `aria-disabled` reflect props; `tabindex="0"` for keyboard focus (`-1` when disabled).
- Stars: each is a `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed` reflecting state and `aria-label` describing the star value. Disabled buttons inherit `:disabled` for screen-reader semantics.
- Counter: `aria-live="polite"` for live announcements.
- Focus indicator: `outline: 2px solid var(--star-color-filled)` on `:focus-visible`.
- Motion: hover scale / bounce / pulse animations are wrapped in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.

---

## 12. Frequently asked questions

**Do I need `lucide-vue-next` if I use FontAwesome or a custom icon?**
No. Since v3.1.0 icon providers are loaded with `defineAsyncComponent`. The static dependency graph from `import { VueStarRate } from 'vue-js-star-rating'` does not include `lucide-vue-next`, so consumer bundlers will not try to resolve it.

**Is it SSR-safe?**
Yes. The default SVG provider renders fully on the server. Async chunks resolve on the client after hydration.

**Does it work with Nuxt 3?**
Yes. For Lucide / FontAwesome providers, wrap the component in `<ClientOnly>` if you need the icon present in the initial HTML.

**What is the bundle size?**
~3 KB gzipped for the default path. Each lazy provider adds its own small chunk only when rendered.

**Can I use it without `v-model`?**
Yes. Pass `:model-value` and listen to `@update:modelValue` (or `@change`). The `useStarRating` composable is exported for headless usage.

**Is it tree-shakeable?**
Yes. `sideEffects` is set to `**/*.css` only, so unused named exports are eliminated by Rollup, Vite, Webpack, and esbuild.

**Which Vue versions are supported?**
Vue 3.5+. The component uses `defineModel`, `useTemplateRef`, and `MaybeRefOrGetter`. Vue 2 is not supported.

---

## 13. Migration

### v3.0 → v3.1 (this release)

- No breaking changes. The only consumer-visible behaviour change is that `LucideIcon` and `FontAwesomeIcon` now resolve asynchronously the first time they are rendered. If you have an explicit `<Suspense>` in your tree you can configure its fallback; otherwise the change is transparent.

### v2 → v3

- `lucideIcons` prop → `iconProvider="lucide"`
- `role="slider"` → `role="group"`
- `animation.scale: 1.15` → `animation.type: 'scale'`
- Vue peer raised from `^3.3.0` → `^3.5.0`
- Options API → Composition API with `defineModel`
